title: Folded Fan · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Folded Fan · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead one sheet of paper. The lead folds the sheet back and forth into an accordion fan without cutting. The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: One sheet of paper.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Folded Fan, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan.
recall.why: The folded sheet opens and closes as a fan.
